package.description: iFun Screenshot is a free, lightweight, yet powerful screenshot tool.

en-US.description: iFun Screenshot is a free, lightweight, yet powerful screenshot tool.
en-US.longDescription: iFun Screenshot provides you multiple screenshot modes. It allows you to quickly capture any selected area, window, or full screen and easily pin them to your desktop, copy them to a clipboard, or save them to other locations according to your needs. Thus, taking screenshots for films, games, webinars, lectures, websites, folders, files, etc., will be easier than ever.
en-US.name: iFun Screenshot
